name: Scroll Mastery
body:
Scroll Mastery (Su)
Source Magical Marketplace pg. 4
Whenever the magus uses a scroll, he may expend 1 point from his arcane pool to allow him to calculate the DC for any spell contained on the scroll using his Intelligence modifier, instead of the minimum modifier needed cast a spell of that level. The magus must be at least 6th level before selecting this arcana.
